parsed.production_notes: The main presenter is clearly an AI-generated avatar, evidenced by her perfectly symmetrical features, uncanny valley smile, and minimal, slightly stiff movements. The screen recording of the mobile app is human-recorded, making the overall production mixed.

characters.appearance: An Indian woman in her late 20s or early 30s with a slim build and a medium-dark complexion. She has long, voluminous, wavy black hair parted to the side. Her facial features are sharp and symmetrical, with large, expressive dark eyes, defined eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. She wears a small red bindi on her forehead.
characters.wardrobe: A crisp, white, long-sleeved collared shirt, a black pencil skirt, a delicate gold necklace with dark beads, and a simple bracelet on her right wrist.
characters.demeanor: Confident, friendly, and encouraging. She maintains direct eye contact with the camera and smiles frequently.
